overview.description: CGH Digitalization is an Electronic Medical Record (EMR) web application designed to streamline patient care workflows and clinical operations.

keyFeatures.title: Improved Patient Care
keyFeatures.description: Real-time clinical data such as vitals, neuro observations, and fall risk scores is available at the point of care instead of being buried in paper charts.

keyFeatures.title: Automated Documentation
keyFeatures.description: Digitized assessment checklists, fall scales, family medical history, and neurological observations replace manual paper entry.

keyFeatures.title: Better Data Accessibility
keyFeatures.description: Centralized patient banners and sidebars surface important information such as height, weight, dietary needs, and frequency across relevant views.

keyFeatures.title: Data Integrity & Safety
keyFeatures.description: Optimistic concurrency control helps prevent multiple staff members from silently overwriting updates to the same patient record.

keyFeatures.title: Role-Based Access
keyFeatures.description: Differentiated access supports workflows such as nurse full access and doctor view-only access on sensitive clinical forms.

keyFeatures.title: Consistency Across Modules
keyFeatures.description: Shared UI and UX patterns, including banner and section scaffolding, provide a consistent experience as new forms are added.

cta.title: Interested in working together?
cta.description: Let's build thoughtful, reliable, and user-focused digital experiences.
